name: Ryan Gravenberch

career_stints.note: All-competitions totals across his Ajax first-team career (3 Eredivisie titles, 2 Dutch cups) before his July 2022 move to Bayern Munich. Deployed as a more advanced central midfielder at Ajax; converted into a deeper defensive-midfield role after joining Liverpool.

Single season, fringe squad role (Bundesliga: 24 appearances but reportedly as few as 3-4 starts, ~576-711 minutes by some in-season counts). Goals/assists across all competitions not reliably verifiable, omitted rather than guessed.

Premier League only, 2025/26 season -- the most recent complete season with a clean, cross-checked figure. Joined Liverpool September 2023 for a reported €40m; a fully reliable cumulative all-competitions total across all three Liverpool seasons to date could not be resolved (one search aggregation suggested roughly 99 appearances / 8 goals / 14 assists since joining, but this could not be cross-verified against a second independent source, so it is flagged here rather than used directly as a stint entry).

notes: touches_per90 (76.0, up from 69.9 the prior season) is from theanalyst.com's 2025/26 Premier League coverage. The same article gives 'carries per 90' at 18.5 (up from 14.4) -- carries is a distinct Opta metric from this schema's progressive_passes_per90, so it was not mapped into that field; progressive_passes_per90 left null rather than substituted.

playstyle_metrics.minutes omitted: no reliable exact 2025/26 minutes total was found (he was a near-ever-present starter across 35 Premier League appearances per multiple sources, but no source gave a precise minutes figure), so the key was left out rather than estimated.

pass_accuracy_pct and duels_won_pct: no reliable season-specific per-90/percentage figure found (only isolated single-match examples, e.g. 'won 7 of 10 duels vs Atlético') -- left null rather than generalized from one match.
Sources: bundesliga.com, fcbayern.com, thisisanfield.com, theanalyst.com, transfermarkt.us, sportbusy.com, premierleague.com -- via web search 2026-08-10.
